ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Creation TXT File in User Desktop
ruleDefinitions.description: Ransomware create txt file in the user Desktop

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*")) AND file_path = RGX("\\\.txt$"))
